title: Grille Lights LED 3-Pack – Surface-Mounted 12V
descriptionHtml:
Extra light in the vehicle's grille

Grille lights and marker lights make the vehicle both better looking and more visible. Worn or missing lights bring down both appearance and safety.

Three lights that are easy to install

This 3-pack of surface-mounted LED lights runs on 12V and is easy to install. They give a clear light and fit most vehicles.

Features

  • 3-pack of surface-mounted LED lights
  • Runs on 12V
  • Easy to install
  • Clear, even light
  • Good as grille and marker lights

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
